---
title: "Opt out"
open-graph: false
twitter-card: false
format:
  html:
    include-in-header:
      - text: |
          <meta property="og:site_name" content="PAGE SITE NAME">
          <meta property="og:title" content="PAGE TITLE">
          <meta name="twitter:title" content="PAGE TITLE">
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - - 'meta[property="og:site_name"][content="PAGE SITE NAME"]'
          - 'meta[property="og:title"][content="PAGE TITLE"]'
          - 'meta[name="twitter:title"][content="PAGE TITLE"]'
        - ['meta[property="og:site_name"][content="SITE TITLE"]']
---

This page turns off Quarto's social metadata and writes its own tags, which must keep their values.
